translations.title: Magnesium Hydroxide 500 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to neutralise stomach acid and ease symptoms of stomach and duodenal ulcers, gastritis and excess stomach acid, and to relieve constipation.
translations.usage: To neutralise acid, take 2–5 tablets (1–2.5 g) a day in divided doses. For constipation, take 2–4 tablets (1–2 g) a day in one or two doses. The dose may be adjusted to suit your age and symptoms.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have kidney problems or diarrhoea. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you have heart problems or high magnesium levels in the blood, and do not take it together with tetracycline antibiotics. Taking it with a lot of milk or calcium supplements can cause milk-alkali syndrome.

summaryTable.How it works: Neutralises stomach acid and relieves constipation
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Kidney problems, diarrhoea, high magnesium levels
summaryTable.Why this one: A magnesium preparation used both to neutralise acid and to relieve constipation
